column3: Show this company's sales, profit, margin and debt trend for the last 3 years.
column4:
Consolidated figures for the years ended 31 March, in Rs crore.
FY2026 profit includes Rs 4,407 crore from the ice cream business, which was demerged and is reported as discontinued operations. Without it, FY2026 profit after tax would be Rs 10,633 crore. FY2025 includes a loss of Rs 9 crore from the same business (Rs 10,658 crore without it). Exceptional items are included in both years, as reported. The margin row uses all profit.
Sales are revenue from operations. Profit after tax is the share of the owners of the company. Margin is profit after tax ÷ sales, calculated by RedixFi. Debt is borrowings plus lease liabilities. Reported figures, not adjusted.
FY2026 and FY2025 are as shown in the annual report for FY2025-26; FY2024 is as shown in the annual report for FY2024-25. That report showed FY2025 sales of Rs 63,121 crore, which differs from the Rs 61,328 crore in the later report.
At 31 March 2026 the debt figure is lease liabilities of Rs 1,478 crore and no borrowings.

List the guidance, capex plans and risks mentioned in the latest concall and annual report.
column4:
The latest filings on file for this company are results and investor presentations, not call transcripts, so this answer is from those and the annual report.
Guidance: Consolidated EBITDA margin to be within the current guided range of 22-24%. Focus on volume-led profit growth under the company's own strategy (results presentation, 28 Oct 2026).
Capex plans: Growth-led capex investment to step up from 2% to 3% of turnover, with capital to be deployed on bolt-on acquisitions (investor presentation, 9 Sep 2026).
Risks named: Commodity inflation is expected to continue in the short term (28 Oct 2026). The auditor's report names the estimates behind provisions and contingent liabilities for tax, litigation and claims as a key audit matter, because the judgement involved is high (annual report FY2025-26).
